**Finding: missing — vendor insurance (severity: low)**

The Agreement has no insurance clause. The single occurrence of "insurance" (p0051) is a cost pass-through obligating *us* to pay taxes, duties, insurance and shipping — not a coverage covenant by SFG. The General Provisions section runs (a) Governing Law through (k) Representation by Counsel and then straight into the signature block, with no insurance subsection anywhere else in the document.

Since SFG operates the Licensed Technology through which our market data and Spot FX orders are transmitted, it is squarely a vendor that touches our data, so zero coverage sits below the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) and near walk-away.

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: new General Provisions subsection **(l) INSURANCE** inserted after p0159 at the preferred position (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where Licensor processes our data, workers' comp as required by law, certificates on request), with the fallback limits flagged in the negotiation comment.
